test_title: PYST 22: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The inclusion of Durga Puja in the UNESCO's list of Intangible Cultural Heritage was only possible due to the arduous ______ of all stakeholders.
solution:
The correct answer is '**efforts**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**efforts**" means a vigorous or determined attempt. (प्रयास)
 
• The inclusion of Durga Puja in the UNESCO's list required the hard work and dedication of all stakeholders.
 
• The other options: "**passivity**," "**affects**," and "**ignorance**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The inclusion of Durga Puja in the UNESCO's list of Intangible Cultural Heritage was only possible due to the arduous efforts__ of all stakeholders.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Passivity (निष्क्रियता)**: means acceptance of what happens without active response or resistance.
 
• **Affects (प्रभाव)**: means having an effect on; make a difference to.
 
• **Ignorance (अज्ञानता)**: means lack of knowledge or information.

31:Tbe6,

The correct answer is: Option 2<
